hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Observe that querying a bit flips its value in the target integer.

hints.title: Reverting Operations
hints.text: Querying with the same single-bit mask twice restores the hidden integer to its state before the pair of queries.

hints.title: Bit Determination
hints.text: Call with zero to establish the baseline count of common bits. If querying bit i yields a count strictly greater than baseline, bit i was initially set.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Makes exactly 61 queries to determine 30 bits.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Single queries alter the state unpredictably without safe restoration.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Leverage self-inverting property of bitwise xor queries.
